sql: SELECT * FROM revisit_pg.rv3_cve_facts WHERE cve = 'CVE-2025-26625' AND pkg = 'git-lfs'

data: "Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. In Git LFS versions 0.5.2 through 3.7.0, when populating a Git repository's working tree with the contents of Git LFS objects, certain Git LFS commands may write to files visible outside the current Git working tree if symbolic or hard links exist which collide with the paths of files tracked by Git LFS. The git lfs checkout and git lfs pull commands do not check for symbolic links before writing to files in the working tree, allowing an attacker to craft a repository containing symbolic or hard links that cause Git LFS to write to arbitrary file system locations accessible to the user running these commands. As well, when the git lfs checkout and git lfs pull commands are run in a bare repository, they could write to files visible outside the repository. The vulnerability is fixed in version 3.7.1. As a workaround, support for symlinks in Git may be disabled by setting the core.symlinks configuration option to false, after which further clones and fetches will not create symbolic links. However, any symbolic or hard links in existing repositories will still provide the opportunity for Git LFS to write to their targets."

sql: SELECT * FROM revisit_pg.rv3_cve_facts WHERE cve = 'CVE-2026-115863' AND pkg = 'connman'

data: "ConnMan through 2.0 has a stack-based buffer overflow via a DHCPv6 Reply message. This occurs in get_domains in gdhcp/client.c. It copies a fixed NS_MAXDNAME (1025) bytes from a DHCPv6 DOMAIN_LIST (option 24) value into a 1026-byte stack buffer dns_name regardless of the actual option length, then walks DNS labels with an unbounded \"c += jump + 1\" loop. A crafted DHCPv6 REPLY with a DOMAIN_LIST option of >= 1025 non-zero bytes makes the label walk leave the buffer and read/write '.' past its end in attacker-chosen strides. An on-link attacker can trigger this without authentication via a forged Router Advertisement (O=1) and a forged DHCPv6 REPLY matching xid/CLIENTID with a long DOMAIN_LIST. The impact is unauthenticated on-link crash of connmand (runs as root). This was introduced in bb06c47."

sql:
SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' released on or before ', u.tag_date) ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_netcdf LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2025_14932 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'

sql: SELECT * FROM revisit_pg.rv3_cve_facts WHERE cve = 'CVE-2026-115877' AND pkg = 'twisted'

data: "Twisted is an event-based framework for internet applications, supporting Python 3.6+. Prior to 26.10.0rc1, twisted.web.http.HTTPChannel.headerReceived rejects a NUL byte in an HTTP header value but accepts a bare carriage return or bare line feed. Because Twisted splits header lines only on CRLF, a hidden Content-Length header can remain folded into another value while a lenient front end treats the bare character as a line terminator. The resulting framing disagreement can smuggle a following request past front-end access controls, poison a shared connection or cache, and expose a later client to the wrong response. This issue is an incomplete-fix residual of earlier Twisted request-smuggling protections. This issue is fixed in version 26.10.0rc1."

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2023-28858|python-redis'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' released on or before ', u.tag_date) ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2023-28858|python-redis'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2023-28858|python-redis'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2023_28858 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2023-28858|python-redis'

sql: SELECT wall, queue FROM revisit_pg.rv3_cve_facts WHERE cve = 'CVE-2026-115863' AND pkg = 'connman'

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' authored ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' already released by ', u.tag_date, ' (the oldest of the newest tags listed)') ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_libsixel LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2022_29977 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'

data: "Twisted is an event-based framework for internet applications, supporting Python 3.6+. Prior to 26.10.0rc1, twisted.conch.telnet.Telnet.dataReceived appends every byte received after IAC SB to a persistent subnegotiation buffer until IAC SE is received, without applying a maximum length. Telnet option negotiation occurs before authentication, so an unauthenticated peer can omit the terminator and continuously grow the buffer. The resulting memory exhaustion can terminate the process and every service it hosts. This issue is fixed in version 26.10.0rc1."

            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2024-13745|edk2'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' released on or before ', u.tag_date) ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2024-13745|edk2'
UNION ALL

       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions

data: "PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE)."

data: "ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in LoadPolicyCache that silently skips security policy rules when policy.xml uses an alternate DOCTYPE. A valid DOCTYPE not ending in ']>' makes the parser consume the rest of the file, so no policy rules are applied and restricted operations become allowed."

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' released on or before ', u.tag_date) ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_libsixel LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2022_29977 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in release tag ', u.release_tags) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END) AS fact, t.note AS detail
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in release tag ', u.release_tags) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL

data: "Caddy is an extensible server platform that uses TLS by default. Prior to version 2.11.1, Caddy's FastCGI path splitting logic computes the split index on a lowercased copy of the request path and then uses that byte index to slice the original path. This is unsafe for Unicode because `strings.ToLower()` can change UTF-8 byte length for some characters. As a result, Caddy can derive an incorrect `SCRIPT_NAME`/`SCRIPT_FILENAME` and `PATH_INFO`, potentially causing a request that contains `.php` to execute a different on-disk file than intended (path confusion). In setups where an attacker can control file contents (e.g., upload features), this can lead to unintended PHP execution of non-.php files (potential RCE depending on deployment). Version 2.11.1 fixes the issue."

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions

       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' authored ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' already released by ', u.tag_date, ' (the oldest of the newest tags listed)') ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
